notes.title: Performance improved V1.045
notes.content: While working on the second campaign, I improved performance a bit. This should be very beneficial for older systems. Also some minor bugfixes are included.

notes.title: Version 1.04 available
notes.content:
My work on the second campaign is progressing - expect the first part it in the next version 1.05, if no major bugs pop up. Today 1.04 includes:

- Ingame menu redone, now also shows short keys
- Different mouse cursors implemented, like a nice crosshair (can be deactivated if not wanted)
- The manual had some broken graphics in 1.03, this has been fixed

Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.03 out now
notes.content:
After a busy weekend I was able to implement some improvements:
- The planet’s atmosphere will start to get darker/dirtier after asteroid impacts. It will recover a bit after each level (so not in endless mode).
- Some more spell checking and minor adjustments.

Then there was a customer request: 
* Andreas, I'm playing with my son on the same device. Can you do more than one continues slots, so that we both can play the campaign.
- Yes, V1.03 comes with four save game slots, so up to four campaigns can be played in parallel.

notes.title: Easter Bunny brought V1.02 with Linux and Mac support
notes.content: V1.02 is out, including minor improvements, bugfixes AND it was successfully tested on Ubuntu 17.01 and MacOS. Next update will be touch controls and after that... we will see. A second campaign would be really cool. What do you think? Tell me in the community hub.
